metadata.purpose: Conservative global human-browser User-Agent profile snapshot for weighted rotation and test automation.
metadata.methodology: July 2026 worldwide platform and browser-family shares were normalized within desktop, mobile, and tablet categories. Browser and operating-system totals were reconciled under documented compatibility constraints, then divided among current, previous, and retained versions using release timing and progressive-rollout assumptions.
metadata.limitations: Cross-dimensional browser-by-OS-by-version telemetry is not publicly available at full fidelity. Version splits and small platform allocations are modeled estimates. User-Agent strings do not synchronize Client Hints, TLS or HTTP/2 fingerprints, JavaScript-visible properties, viewport, locale, cookies, or proxy geography. Refresh or replace this dated snapshot as browser releases and measured traffic change.
metadata.curation_policy: Publish only internally consistent browser, engine, platform, and device-token combinations with defensible support. Exclude doubtful exact strings instead of padding the matrix.
